network_status.summary_it: La pagina regionale include l'evento del 27-28 novembre 2012 e gli interventi conseguenti, ma non pubblica un colmo idrometrico sul fiume Orcia associabile al ponte delle Nove Luci. I valori dell'evento dell'11-12 novembre non vengono riutilizzati per una piena distinta.
network_status.summary_en: The regional page covers the 27-28 November 2012 event and subsequent works but publishes no Orcia hydrometric peak attributable to the Nove Luci bridge. Values from the separate 11-12 November flood are not reused.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
